objective: Close the evidence-freshness gap where a valid native-4K temporal/LOD sequence could remain scoreable after render-affecting candidate inputs changed and new still evidence was sealed for a different candidate.

decision.priorityReason: Temporal/LOD/aliasing carries 5 points and two critical automatic FAIL conditions (severe aliasing/shimmering and visible LOD pop). Source/runtime validity of an old temporal sequence is insufficient unless it is also current for the exact still-render candidate being scored.
decision.reasonVisualExpansionDeferred: No Unity Runner or actual rendered evidence is available. Provenance hardening increases scoring integrity without claiming unobserved visual quality.

changes.summary: Added QualityBlockTemporalCandidateCoherenceQA. It binds temporal runtime receipt bytes to the current fresh native-4K still candidate SHA-256, candidate epoch and persisted scene SHA-256, and refuses temporal evidence older than the candidate mutation/latest tracked input write.
Added machine-readable temporal_candidate_coherence_contract.json with zero automatic visual points and explicit stale-evidence failure policy.
Raised reviewed visual evidence integrity contract to schema 1.3 and made current temporal-to-still candidate coherence a mandatory scoring precondition.
Wired temporal candidate coherence directly into reviewed Visual Fidelity scoring before temporal runtime evidence validation; contract validation also fail-closes if the integration is weakened.

sourceReview: Reviewed scoring path calls QualityBlockTemporalCandidateCoherenceQA.ValidateForScoring before accepting temporal runtime evidence.
Coherence validation first requires QualityBlockRenderCandidateFreshnessQA.ValidateCurrentCandidateFreshness, so stale still evidence cannot legitimize stale temporal evidence.
Temporal runtime receipt SHA-256, capture session, scene SHA-256, candidate combined SHA-256 and exact candidate epoch must match the current coherence seal.
Temporal generatedUtc must not predate either current candidate mutation UTC or candidate latest tracked input write UTC.
Import-time sealing deletes/invalidates prior coherence on failure; a manual seal command applies the same fail-closed checks.
All new QA paths award zero Visual Fidelity points and cannot clear severe_aliasing_or_shimmer or visible_lod_pop.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.temporal_lod_aliasing: Evidence reliability improvement only. Does not predict or award any of the 5 points; it prevents stale temporal pixels from supporting this category.
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.note: No critical defect is cleared by source/provenance checks. Direct 100%-pixel temporal review remains mandatory.

nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner/Editor execution. On first real run, verify compile, still candidate freshness seal, temporal runtime receipt import/coherence sealing, then mutate a tracked render input and prove old temporal coherence fails before recapturing actual native-4K still/temporal evidence.
